title: relay agent permissions
description: `relay setup` installs harness permission rules so the agent runs relay commands without a prompt and `relay human` commands still prompt.

title: Command forms
description:
List the command forms the agent uses to invoke relay.
owns: `command_forms(install_path)` in relay/forms.py
- [ ] `command_forms(install_path)` returns `relay` and the real path of `install_path`

title: Binary identity
description:
Add binary identity helpers so setup can tell whether a form runs the relay that is running setup.
owns: `binary_digest(path)`, `resolve_form(form, path_env)` and `running_relay()` in relay/identity.py
- [ ] `binary_digest(path)` is the SHA-256 hex digest of the file's bytes
- [ ] `resolve_form("relay", path_env)` is the real path of `relay` found on `path_env`, or `None`; an absolute form resolves to its own real path, or `None` when it is not a file
- [ ] `running_relay()` is the real path of `sys.argv[0]`, looked up on `PATH` when it is not a file path

title: Rule set by binary identity
description:
Rework `build_rules` in relay/rules.py to allow a form only when it runs the running relay (B1).
owns: `build_rules(forms, running_digest, form_digest)` returning the rules and the forms left without an allow rule
consumes: digests from rl.2
- [ ] every form F gets a prompt rule `F human *`
- [ ] a form whose digest equals the running relay's digest also gets an allow rule `F *`
- [ ] a form with another digest, or none, gets no allow rule and is returned as held

title: Setup allows both forms in one run
description:
Rework `run_setup` in relay/install.py so a default `relay setup` computes the running relay's digest and each form's digest and writes the rules in the same run (B1).
owns: `run_setup(settings_path, install_path, running_path, path_env, out)` in relay/install.py; `relay setup` in relay/cli.py passes `running_relay()`
consumes: `command_forms` from rl.1, identity helpers from rl.2, `build_rules` from rl.3
- [ ] on an ordinary install, a default `relay setup` writes allow rules for bare `relay` and the absolute path and a `human` prompt rule for each, in one run with no other step
- [ ] for each held form, `relay setup` prints `relay setup: F does not resolve to the running relay; F stays prompted`
- [ ] `relay setup` replaces only relay-owned rules and leaves rules of other tools unchanged; running it twice gives the same file

title: Tests for binary identity
description:
Cover binary identity and setup in tests/ (B1).
consumes: `run_setup` from rl.4, identity helpers from rl.2
- [ ] a test installs one relay file, puts it on `PATH` and as `install_path`, runs `run_setup` with it as the running relay and checks both forms are allowed and `human` prompts in both (B1)
- [ ] a test puts a different file named `relay` on `PATH` and checks the bare form gets only its prompt rule while the absolute form stays allowed
- [ ] a test checks other tools' rules are kept and a second run gives the same file
